text: For the At large Mayor of Oakland race, Barbara Lee's record includes congressional votes and mayoral actions. In Congress she voted No on the $14 billion Israel weapons transfer, the 2024 NDAA with Israeli funding, and the IHRA "anti-Zionism is antisemitism" codification, but Yes on the PLO entry ban, the "human shields" sanctions, the Treasury tax-exempt designation, the IHRA antisemitism resolution, the "only Hamas surrender" resolution, and the resolution condemning pro-Palestine college students. She was present on one IHRA vote and did not vote on the Israel right-to-exist resolution. She publicly condemned suppression of Gaza death toll figures as "genocide denial" and co-issued a statement calling for a permanent ceasefire. AIPAC thanked her for pro-Israel provisions in the FY2024 funding bill. As Mayor she backed halting Israeli military cargo shipments through the Port of Oakland and stated she has long supported Israel's right to exist peacefully. CAIR Action and AROC Action endorsed her; Vote for Peace listed her as Ally and supported; the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club also endorsed her.
